audit.why: full phases[N].side and content win[N] agree row for row and match the packet: Cho'Gath 1-2, Skill at 3, Master Yi 4-5 through first item, Cho'Gath at 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content spikes carry no cooldowns; the level 6 spike says Highlander 'doesn't change the lane much' without naming either timer.
audit.why: Feast is 80/70/60s against Highlander's flat 85s — his ult is up more often than yours, which is exactly why 6 is not your swing. Rupture is 6s and Feral Scream 11s at rank 1, which is what makes short trades safe.
audit.corrected: spikes[0..2] and mid now carry the Q, W, R and Highlander numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Feral Scream's silence appears nowhere in the content layer — the only ability of his the page never mentions. Nothing says Rupture's knockup or the silence ends a Meditate channel either.
audit.why: The silence is what actually kills Master Yi here: it removes Alpha Strike, his only escape, for its duration. A player who pre-casts Alpha Strike to poke and then gets screamed has nothing left.
audit.corrected: Feral Scream (W, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s) silences — hold Alpha Strike until it is spent instead of pre-casting. Rupture (Q, 6s) knocks up and both it and the silence break Meditate. Alpha Strike's untargetability is the only clean answer to a Feast cast.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0] has him zoning you with Rupture AND Vorpal Spikes at level 1.
audit.why: He has one ability at level 1; the level 1 threat is Rupture's range and knockup alone.

edits.before: Once you have Q Alpha Strike, E Wuju Style, and W Meditate you can trade back through his Rupture and Vorpal Spikes since your true damage punishes his lack of sustain before Warmog stacking.
edits.after: With Alpha Strike, Wuju Style (14s) and Meditate (10s) you can trade back — but Feral Scream (W, 11s at rank 1) SILENCES you, so hold Alpha Strike until the scream is spent instead of pre-casting it.

edits.before: Your Highlander doesn't change the lane much, but Cho's level 6 Feast gives him a point-and-click execute — never sit below its true-damage threshold when he can walk up.
edits.after: Highlander (85s) barely shifts the lane, but Feast (R, 80s at rank 1) is point-and-click true damage — Alpha Strike's untargetable window is the only thing that blanks the cast.

edits.before: After your first attack-speed item your DPS window opens; you kill him faster than he can Q-W-Feast if you dodge the knockup with Alpha Strike.
edits.after: After your first attack-speed item you kill him faster than he can Q-W-Feast — but his Rupture knockup and his W silence both end a Meditate channel.

edits.before: Cho'Gath's Rupture and Vorpal Spikes zone your weak level 1 autos before you have Wuju Style.
edits.after: Cho'Gath's Rupture outranges your level 1 autos and knocks you up before you have Wuju Style.

edits.before: From level 3 you can trade Wuju Style true damage back through his poke, and levels 4-5 favour you because his cooldowns are long and his sustain is thin before Warmog — but the moment he hits 6, his Feast is a hard execute you must never sit under.
edits.after: From level 3 you trade Wuju Style true damage back through his poke, and levels 4-5 favour you since Rupture is 6s and Feral Scream 11s — but from 6 his Feast is point-and-click true damage, so never sit under its threshold when he can walk up.

edits.before: Bank his level 6 Feast to point-and-click execute you low
edits.after: Silence you with Feral Scream, then point-and-click Feast

notes: Feral Scream's silence was completely absent from the content layer and is the interaction that decides this lane for Master Yi — a silenced Yi has no escape and no untargetability. Also worth knowing: Feast is 80/70/60s while Highlander is a flat 85s, so his ult is available more often than yours; the page's 'level 6 is my swing' framing in the full layer overstates it, though the level chart itself is right for the other reasons given. Not verified and therefore not written: whether Alpha Strike cast in the same instant as a Feast cast reliably blanks it, or whether Feast's damage applies on cast start.
